name: Moodle
description: Moodle is the world’s most customisable and trusted eLearning solution that empowers educators to improve our world.
composeYaml:
services:
  mariadb:
    image: 'mariadb:11.1'
    environment:
      - ALLOW_EMPTY_PASSWORD=no
      - MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD=${ROOT_PASSWORD}
      - MYSQL_DATABASE=bitnami_moodle
      - MYSQL_USER=${MARIADB_USER}
      - MYSQL_PASSWORD=${MARIADB_PASSWORD}
      - MARIADB_CHARACTER_SET=utf8mb4
      - MARIADB_COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci
    volumes:
      - 'mariadb-data:/var/lib/mysql'
    healthcheck:
      test:
        - CMD-SHELL
        - "bash -c '</dev/tcp/localhost/3306'"
      interval: 10s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 5
  moodle:
    image: 'docker.io/bitnamilegacy/moodle:4.3'
    depends_on:
      - mariadb
    environment:
      - MOODLE_DATABASE_HOST=mariadb
      - MOODLE_DATABASE_PORT_NUMBER=3306
      - MOODLE_DATABASE_USER=${MARIADB_USER}
      - MOODLE_DATABASE_NAME=bitnami_moodle
      - MOODLE_DATABASE_PASSWORD=${MARIADB_PASSWORD}
      - ALLOW_EMPTY_PASSWORD=no
      - 'MOODLE_USERNAME=${MOODLE_USERNAME:-user}'
      - MOODLE_PASSWORD=${MOODLE_PASSWORD}
      - MOODLE_EMAIL=user@example.com
      - 'MOODLE_SITE_NAME=${MOODLE_SITE_NAME:-New Site}'
    volumes:
      - 'moodle-data:/bitnami/moodle'
      - 'moodledata-data:/bitnami/moodledata'
    healthcheck:
      test:
        - CMD
        - php
        - '-r'
        - "exit(file_exists('/opt/bitnami/moodle/config.php') ? 0 : 1);"
      interval: 20s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 5

meta.about: Learning and courses platform with one of the largest open source communities worldwide.
